flight.duration_h.source: docs/SPEC.md §1 Flight duration ≥ 4 h (brief ~4 hour flight)

power.pack_chemistry.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.1 Energizer L91 Ultimate Lithium AA; forbidden alkaline and LiPo 1S

power.series_cells.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.1 Topology: 3 cells baseline, 4 cells allowed only if host VIN/UVLO requires it

power.pack_voltage_V.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.1 Pack voltage 3s 3.0–5.4 V and 4s 4.0–7.2 V (EOD–fresh); combined bound 3.0–7.2 V

power.mean_flight_current_mA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.2 ASSUMED average pack current ≤ 200 mA mean over 4 h (GPS on + ESP32 + OpenLog + APRS/WSPR TX duty)

power.flight_energy_mAh.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.2 Design margin: usable pack capacity ≥ 2× flight energy → ≥ 1600 mAh vs 800 mAh load after ASSUMED cold derate

power.switch_off_current_uA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 Switch OFF pack current: 0 µA except holder/switch leakage; switch must break the pack positive

power.board_added_idle_mA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 Switch ON, cutdown OFF: board-added Iq (LED off, MOSFET off, OpenLog idle) ≤ 2 mA beyond LightAPRS-W 2.0

power.cutdown_off_leakage_uA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 Cutdown MOSFET/relay OFF leakage ≤ 50 µA at max pack voltage

power.led_off_leakage_uA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 Write LED OFF leakage ≤ 1 µA (no bleed path that looks like a glow)

power.gpio_logic_V.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.4 GPIO / LED / FET gate: 3.3 V logic from LightAPRS-W 3V3, not raw pack

openlog.vcc_V.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.4 / §4 OpenLog VCC 3.3–12 V (module); tie to 3.3 V unless 3V3 LDO current share is exceeded

antenna.connector.source: docs/SPEC.md §3 Two SMA jacks facing downward through the payload; 50 Ω; APRS and WSPR

cutdown.load_current_A.source: docs/SPEC.md §5 Cutdown current ASSUMED ≤ 2 A burst for ≤ 30 s; FET/relay and trace must carry this

cutdown.vgs_fully_on_V.value: must be fully enhanced at 3.3 V Vgs; IRLZ44N not auto-approved
cutdown.vgs_fully_on_V.source: docs/SPEC.md §5 IRLZ44N Rds(on) is specified at 5 V Vgs; at 3.3 V it may not be fully on — stop rather than silently use IRLZ44N

power.strap_leakage_uA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 Pull-ups/downs on host GPIOs: extra leakage through straps ≤ 50 µA total; check MCU strapping table before any pin

antenna.keepout_mm.source: docs/SPEC.md §3 Keepout: ASSUMED ≥ 5 mm board keepout from SMA dielectric; no battery metal in the near-field of the jacks

host.free_gpio.value: J2.3 A1/PB08 is one-way OpenLog UART_TX; J2.4 A2/PB09 is direct CUTDOWN_CTRL; A0 is unused; shared J2.7/J2.8 I2C serves U1; occupied GPS/radio/SPI pins remain forbidden
host.free_gpio.source: docs/PINOUT.md Host interface J2; docs/SUBSYSTEMS.md §2 and §6

firmware.cutdown_boot_state.value: CUTDOWN_CTRL must be driven low/off before any other application-level initialization; R3 remains the reset-time hardware default-off path
firmware.cutdown_boot_state.source: docs/SPEC.md §5 Default-off and firmware/DEVPLAN.md Happy-path acceptance

firmware.openlog_baud.value: 9600 baud scaffold default; verify against the installed OpenLog configuration before flight

power.openlog_idle_mA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 allocation after adding U1; docs/BOM.md budget notes

power.led_expander_idle_uA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 allocation and docs/BOM.md U1 acceptance limit

mechanical.lightaprs_module_zone.value: exact 32.77 x 54.80 mm zone, long axis vertical; FACE-UP top-view geometry with no left-right mirror; J2 on matching right long edge; J7 HF bottom-left and J6 VHF bottom-right; vendor drawing 42.73 mm long-axis hole span rotates to PCB vertical
